editor_note: I checked the six rewritten entries (9, 44, 65, 67–69) against the English and found no semantic drift. The condition on bounded integer variables, error codes 4710 and 4712, the postprocessing_level mapping and its unchanged default of 3, and the bitstring/variable_mapping explanation all match the source. Two wording points would still need an editor. In [67], "Breaking changes" becomes "Changements majeurs", which says "major changes" and drops the warning that existing code will stop working; "Changements incompatibles" keeps that meaning. In [69], "Documentation du fait que…" is a stiff nominal calque; "Il est désormais précisé que…" reads more naturally.

examples.why: "Majeurs" only means "major". It loses the warning that these renames break existing code, which is what a changelog's "breaking changes" heading is for. This is minor because the bullets below still describe the renames clearly.

examples.source: Documented that continuous (real-valued) variables are not supported and that integer variables require explicit bounds.
examples.translation: Documentation du fait que les variables continues (à valeurs réelles) ne sont pas prises en charge et que les variables entières nécessitent des bornes explicites.
examples.suggested: Il est désormais précisé que les variables continues (à valeurs réelles) ne sont pas prises en charge et que les variables entières nécessitent des bornes explicites.
examples.why: "Documentation du fait que" is a stiff nominal calque of "Documented that". A French technical writer would phrase it as a statement.

editor_note: Entry 28 is faithful. The claim that QPU time is "minimal et presque constant" because only one QAOA round runs, with parameters optimized on a CPU, keeps its meaning and its causal link, and "tour de QAOA" matches entry 15. The only thing an editor would change is the problem name: entry 28 writes "problème market split" in lowercase, but entries 24, 25, 29 and 58 all write "Market Split" with capitals. "dans la section description" reads better as "dans la section Description", since it names the section heading.

examples.line_approx: Tableau 1 : métriques de performance pour différentes instances du problème market split.
examples.source: Performance metrics for different instances of the market split problem.
examples.translation: métriques de performance pour différentes instances du problème market split. [...] Comme mentionné précédemment dans la section description
examples.suggested: métriques de performance pour différentes instances du problème Market Split. [...] Comme mentionné précédemment dans la section Description
examples.why: Elsewhere in the file the problem name is capitalized as 'Market Split' (entries 24, 25, 29, 58), so this entry should match. 'Description' refers to the section heading and reads more naturally with a capital.

editor_note: The three rewritten entries (40, 41, 44) keep the meaning: the ibm_miami figures (raw below 10 % from width 9 with 10 qubits, Orbit around 80–90 %), the ibm_kingston figures (about 15 % near width 60), the closing caveat and N = 50 / 51 qubits all match the English. The new text is not consistent with the rest of the page, though. Entries 41 and 44 say 'chaîne de bits cachée' where entries 23, 25, 46 and 65 say 'chaîne binaire cachée'. Entry 44 says 'dans un seul job' where entries 38 and 57 use 'tâche'. 'Pour préserver le temps de QPU' in entry 44 is a calque; 'économiser' is what a French writer would use.

examples.translation: à mesure que la largeur de la chaîne de bits cachée augmente
examples.suggested: à mesure que la largeur de la chaîne binaire cachée augmente
examples.why: Elsewhere on the page (entries 23, 25, 46, 65) the term is 'chaîne binaire cachée'. The rewritten entries 41 and 44 switch to 'chaîne de bits cachée'.

examples.source: comparing raw execution with Orbit defaults in a single job
examples.translation: en comparant l'exécution brute aux paramètres par défaut d'Orbit dans un seul job
examples.suggested: en comparant l'exécution brute aux paramètres par défaut d'Orbit dans une seule tâche
examples.why: Entry 38 describes the same single submission as 'en une seule tâche', and entry 57 also uses 'tâche', so 'job' here breaks consistency.

examples.source: To preserve QPU time, this tutorial does not rerun a size sweep.
examples.translation: Pour préserver le temps de QPU, ce tutoriel ne relance pas un balayage de tailles.
examples.suggested: Pour économiser du temps QPU, ce tutoriel ne relance pas de balayage en taille.
examples.why: 'Préserver le temps' copies the English 'preserve'. French would say 'économiser', and after a negation the article should be 'de', not 'un'.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries keep the meaning. In [72], Q is still the control and Alice's qubit the target, and the CNOT-then-Hadamard order is unchanged. In [73], the LaTeX matches the English, and "Comme A et Q se trouvent au même endroit, regroupons les termes…" is faithful. The one thing to fix is in [72]: "Alice agit maintenant avec une porte CNOT avec Q comme contrôle" copies the English "operates with … with" and repeats "avec". A French technical writer would write "applique une porte CNOT".

examples.source: Alice now operates with a CNOT gate with Q as the control and her own qubit as the target, then applies a Hadamard gate to Q.
examples.translation: Alice agit maintenant avec une porte CNOT avec Q comme contrôle et son propre qubit comme cible, puis applique une porte Hadamard à Q.
examples.suggested: Alice applique maintenant une porte CNOT, avec Q comme contrôle et son propre qubit comme cible, puis une porte Hadamard sur Q.
examples.why: "Agit avec une porte … avec Q" copies the English "operates with" and repeats "avec", which reads stiffly. "Appliquer une porte" is the usual French phrasing, and the same text already uses it later in this sentence and in [64]. The meaning is correct.

editor_note: I checked the three rewritten entries (53, 78, 87) against the English and found no change in meaning. The "more than one entry" condition, "only the first solution", the seed_transpiler reproducibility advice and the four option names in the tips all carry over, and the tu register is kept throughout. Two wording slips remain. In entry 78, "adressée par nom de variable" copies the English "addressed by" too literally; "indexée (or accessible) par nom de variable" would read naturally. In entry 87, "Expérimente avec les options" is an anglicism; "Teste les options" or "Expérimente les options" is more idiomatic.

examples.source: Only the first solution is considered here, addressed by variable name.
examples.translation: Seule la première solution est prise en compte ici, adressée par nom de variable.
examples.suggested: Seule la première solution est prise en compte ici, avec un accès aux valeurs par nom de variable.
examples.why: "adressée" copies the English "addressed" too literally. In French, a solution is "indexée" or "accessible" by variable name, not "adressée".

examples.source: Experiment with the algorithm options (`reps`, ...) on your own constrained binary optimization problem
examples.translation: Expérimente avec les options de l'algorithme (`reps`, ...) sur ton propre problème
examples.suggested: Teste les options de l'algorithme (`reps`, ...) sur ton propre problème
examples.why: "Expérimenter avec" is a calque of "experiment with". "Tester" or the transitive "expérimenter les options" reads more naturally to a French technical reader.

editor_note: Entry 60 does not drift in meaning: "Benchmark" becomes "Évaluer", which matches entry 46, and Orbit, QFT and Quantum Elements are all kept. One naturalness slip: "fidélité du processus QFT" turns the technical term "process fidelity" into "the fidelity of the QFT process". A French quantum engineer would write "fidélité de processus de la QFT". Outside this run's scope (only checks 1 and 3 were requested): "une fonction Qiskit" translates the house-kept name "Qiskit Function", and entry 57 keeps "Qiskit Functions" in English.

examples.source: Benchmark QFT process fidelity with Orbit, a Qiskit Function by Quantum Elements
examples.translation: Évaluer la fidélité du processus QFT avec Orbit, une fonction Qiskit de Quantum Elements
examples.suggested: Évaluer la fidélité de processus de la QFT avec Orbit, une Qiskit Function de Quantum Elements
examples.why: "Process fidelity" is a fixed metric, conventionally "fidélité de processus" in French. "Fidélité du processus QFT" reads like a calque, as if "processus QFT" were the thing being measured.

editor_note: Entry 12 is faithful and reads naturally. The sign-mixed random $J_{ij}$, the triangular example and the inability to minimise all interactions at once all match the English, and "compounded globally" is rendered well as "s'amplifie à l'échelle du système entier, donnant lieu à un réseau de contraintes contradictoires".

Entry 5 is the misleading one. "limitations in Quantum Compute [3]" became "limitations dans Runtime Batch child [3]", which ties the stretch-variable limitations of reference [3] to the batching mechanism instead of the Quantum Compute service. The same entry, like entry 11, also leaves "child job(s)" in English, while entries 4, 32, 49 and 51 use "job enfant". The other problems are minor naturalness slips: a garbled adjective order in entry 10 ("dynamique QFT améliorée par Orbit") and entry 35 ("équivalent semi-classique QFT dynamique"), "Un grand N_VALUES" in entry 32, which reads as a long list rather than large values, and "du IBM Quantum Compute Service" in entry 4.

examples.source: they are subject to limitations in Quantum Compute [[3]](#references) that could cause job failures
examples.translation: ils sont sujets à des limitations dans Runtime Batch child [[3]](#references) qui pourraient provoquer des échecs de jobs
examples.suggested: ils sont soumis à des limitations de Quantum Compute [[3]](#references) susceptibles de provoquer des échecs de jobs
examples.why: The wrong referent was swapped in. The limitations belong to the Quantum Compute service (reference [3], stretch variables), not to the Runtime Batch child jobs. This points the learner at the wrong cause of failures.

examples.source: across three Runtime Batch child jobs ... remains in one child job
examples.translation: sur trois Runtime Batch child jobs ... reste dans un seul child job
examples.suggested: sur trois jobs enfants du Runtime Batch ... reste dans un seul job enfant
examples.why: English word order and the English noun are kept as-is. Elsewhere the file uses 'job enfant' (entries 4, 32, 49, 51).
This is inconsistent with 'job enfant' used in the rest of the file.

examples.source: Compare raw unitary, raw dynamic, and Orbit-enhanced dynamic QFT process-fidelity estimates
examples.translation: Comparer les estimations de fidélité de processus unitaire brute, dynamique brute et dynamique QFT améliorée par Orbit
examples.suggested: Comparer les estimations de fidélité de processus de la QFT pour les implémentations unitaire brute, dynamique brute et dynamique améliorée par Orbit
examples.why: The calqued word order puts 'QFT' in the middle of the third list item, so the noun phrase is hard to parse.

examples.source: Large `N_VALUES` create more complex dynamic circuits
examples.translation: Un grand `N_VALUES` crée des circuits dynamiques plus complexes
